authority.precedingDeliverableRequest: I want a fucking zip file with the 11 pending done
authority.interpretation: The owner requests completion of the remaining Director work and a Codex handoff. This is delegated design authorship and bounded synthetic test-fixture construction authority for these eleven identities, not a fabricated verbatim adoption of unseen terms.
authority.newDecision: I authorize the explicit new spell-local models in this package and conditional TEST_ONLY fixture construction under them. This replaces the need for another routine proposal/adoption round for this exact bounded static scope. It does not retroactively claim any historical adoption or native source authority.
authority.role: Director authors models and conditional dispositions; Codex constructs, verifies and applies the authored-review records in priority order. No GitHub writes are performed by this package.

scopeSeparation: Synthetic facts are admitted only as explicit fixtures for static authored-procedure review. Prior requirements for actual source/campaign/faction/planar/deity authority remain unfulfilled outside this scope.
The useful positive effects and adverse behavior listed in each contract must actually be demonstrated; no component-only, unknown-only or paper-only witness substitutes for them.

All original question dispositions, qualification records, history/death limits and source conflicts are retained byte-for-byte. A synthetic fixture is not a resolution of a conflict in real evidence.

This package contains new Director models and test specifications, not new completed paid-cast witnesses for the ten newly authored models. The bundled Collapse Timeline evidence is separately identified.

engineUnits.collision: positive-volume overlap is collision; boundary contact is permitted; floors support the complete load-bearing footprint
engineUnits.range: use the bound shared range convention; fixture endpoints are comfortably inside range so no new edge convention is inferred

castPipeline: Resolve stable identity, native class/school/rank, acquired ordinary repertoire and current preparation, components and hands, current budgets, targets, consent, known defenses, range/LoE and operation registry. Publicly known illegal declarations are rejected before commitment; do not expose hidden protective reasons.

Create a unique cast ID. At legal commitment spend the real Action and final RP price, apply current class Dissonance/Refrain and prepared-family history, set lastSpell and magicThisTurn, install concentration if required, and retain old-source endings caused by that commitment. No free cast or refund on interruption.

Open the actual shared response window after commitment. Record every eligible responder with access, distance, perception, Reaction, price/recharge and explicit action or decline. Do not rule on self-counter eligibility from mere non-use.

At resolution revalidate versioned target/source/geometry predicates. Interrupt/failure clears pendingCast while preserving paid costs/history. Success commits exact result atomically, creates its stable source/receipt and clears pendingCast.

Run real regular START/END bookkeeping exactly once. magicThisTurn survives END and resets only at the next regular START where the bound class rule says so. Idle reductions only on eligible idle ENDs. No extra START, resource reset, hidden rest, deferred free Action or duplicated reaction.

A duplicate callback first checks its exact receipt key and returns the existing outcome without new charges, callbacks, history, cargo or benefits. Distinct paid casts use distinct keys; history and finite-use rules still prevent farming where specified.

profileConstruction.required: Construct class-17-or-higher fixtures from the bound class engine and actual ordinary learning/preparation rules. Bind every choice, ability score, proficiency, derived HP/RP/AC/DC/save, acquired spell and prepared entry. A class eligibility row alone is not acquisition.
profileConstruction.selectionPolicy: Use a legal single-class level-17 build and ordinary target-spell acquisition at its first legal opportunity; choose legal prerequisite cards deterministically and disclose them. Avoid optional cost modifiers where legally possible; otherwise compute them. No source-incompatible free acquisition, preparation slot or initial RP is authorized.
profileConstruction.freshFixture: A separate initialized test state may start at lawful maximum resources with a declared hypothetical completed rest/preparation history; this is setup, never an in-encounter refill. Separate branches do not import each other's history.
profileConstruction.nativeRouteCoverage: At least one legal paid positive cast per native class route for each new model; multiple routes may be isolated variants of the same useful fixture. Specific minimum distinct positive encounters in the source holds still apply.
profileConstruction.extraSources: Bind any shared provider/ward/healing/Null operation actually exercised. A synthetic provider input tests an interface only and must be labeled; it cannot certify a provider cast or satisfy an explicitly paid provider test.

defaultBody.type: use the exact constructed profile type; do not infer Undead or another type

fixtureGeometry.equipment: Each actor begins with one bound legal focus in the left hand, right hand free, owned worn gear and pack with item IDs, weight/Load and nonoverlapping occupied envelopes specified by Codex. Carried items may overlap their own carrier only by the explicit attachment relation, never unrelated bodies.
fixtureGeometry.routes: Use explicit waypoint and swept-body/item bounds with source obstacle planes; moving entities never teleport except where a new contract expressly says so. Mutually exclusive branches never share occupancy.
fixtureGeometry.sceneChanges: The exact per-spell fixtures below override only their stated site cells and entities. Record each added object and support; an unspecified cell or missing record is not empty by inference.

lifecycle: Use elapsed deadlines; save/load, map unload and suppression do not pause, restart or extend them. Once an effect ended it cannot resume. No skipped-event catch-up attacks, delayed commands or bonus actions.

Suppression must bind an accepted provider and actual expression locus; suppress only covered ongoing expressions, not completed physical changes or acquired ordinary memories. Where this package authors a special safe-release rule it is explicit in that spell.
Current HP, wounds, death, real inventory, charges, ownership and current caster resources are never restored by expiry/recast unless an explicit authorized effect actually heals or moves that field.

Ownership and custody are separate. Intrinsic manifestation matter ends with its source; real borrowed cargo persists and settles to supported geometry, using the actual fall rule if unsupported. No manufactured money, free duplicates or silent deletion.

Audit inverse replay restores the serialized branch start for verification only. It is not an available gameplay power or a refund, resurrection, usable save-scum permission or refreshed one-use entitlement.
requiredEvidence: Exact committed source bytes/Git blob hashes, source pointers, native routes and the package contract hash.
Explicit synthetic fixture authorization provenance; no false claim that the owner dictated numeric values or that a campaign event occurred.
Complete legal paid cast and all regular marker/resource/response history, successful useful effect, declared adverse cases and exact endpoint.
Every before/after snapshot, stable source/target/body/item IDs, preconditioned forward and reverse patches, canonical state hash algorithm and exact restored start.
Separate semantic assertions for actual effect behavior, costs, useful output, geometry, privacy, custody, terminal clocks and no duplicate action. Reversibility alone does not prove semantics.
Preserve historical cases without replaying unchanged cases merely to inflate counts; provide obligation-to-new-case crosswalk and retained limitations.
Validation is executed by Codex; report actual checks/failures and tool/environment. Do not label a same-builder check independent, or claim Unity/runtime behavior from JSON replay.

conditionalAcceptance.condition: For each identity, exact model/source bindings, complete paid useful native-route coverage, every specified positive/adverse case, full state/custody/resource semantics and forward/inverse checks must pass. The retained qualifications and scope must remain intact.
conditionalAcceptance.onAllConditionsTrue: Codex may record this hash-bound Director conditional acceptance as satisfied for STATIC_AUTHORED_PROCEDURE_REVIEW_ONLY, then separately apply it to the authored-review index and a successor queue, one identity at a time in ORDER. No further routine Director or owner-adoption round is required for exact compliant work.
conditionalAcceptance.notAnUnconditionalAcceptance: An unbuilt or failing model is not accepted or applied. This package itself changes no repository counters.
conditionalAcceptance.exception: Stop the affected identity only for a material contradiction with a retained binding, failed required behavior, missing legal class construction, a necessary design change, or requested native/runtime/canon expansion. Return one consolidated concrete discrepancy; do not re-ask for already granted design/fixture authority.
conditionalAcceptance.sourceBlockers: Keep the native-source blocker records and downstream qualifications OPEN/RETAINED outside static scope. Record static evidence resolution separately rather than editing history or falsely declaring actual-source qualification.
